answer: Co-occurrence discounting: the ledger counts how often two identities appear in the same thread, grading panel or payment chain each epoch. Any pair that keeps showing up together has its votes and attestations weighted by 1/(1+overlap), so a comet tail of clones moving through every thread side by side ends up worth about one voice. To dodge it, an operator must scatter its identities like a zephyr, giving up the coordination that made the farm worth running.
